claim: In its fiscal fourth-quarter 2026 results on 25 November 2026, Deere & Company forecasts fiscal 2027 net income (midpoint of its range) above the net income it reports for fiscal 2026.

runs.yes_requires: Deere & Company must publish its fiscal fourth-quarter 2026 earnings release within the stated November 25, 2026 America/Chicago window. The release must give a dollar outlook for fiscal 2027 net income attributable to Deere & Company whose midpoint (or single figure) strictly exceeds the fiscal 2026 net income attributable to Deere & Company reported in that same release.
runs.decided_by: The publication time and contents of Deere & Company's official fiscal fourth-quarter 2026 earnings release.

runs.yes_requires: Deere & Company must publish its fiscal Q4 2026 earnings release on 25 November 2026 (US Central time), and the release must state a fiscal 2027 dollar outlook for net income attributable to Deere & Company whose midpoint (or single figure) exceeds the reported fiscal 2026 net income attributable to Deere & Company in the same release.
runs.decided_by: Deere & Company's official fiscal fourth-quarter 2026 earnings release.

runs.yes_requires: Deere publishes its fiscal Q4 2026 earnings release on 25 November 2026 within the America/Chicago window, and that release gives a fiscal 2027 dollar outlook for net income attributable to Deere & Company as a single figure, or as a range whose midpoint is strictly higher than the fiscal 2026 net income attributable to Deere & Company reported in the same release.
runs.decided_by: The figures and outlook in Deere & Company's earnings release published on 25 November 2026 (US Central time / America/Chicago).
